summary: SafeDeal security RETEST iteration 225 — all previously 429-blocked cases (R1..R6) now PASS with the new per-route rate-limit buckets. 11/11 pytest tests passed; throwaway rows purged (R7).

detailed_results.R1_stepup_bruteforce_lockout: PASS — POST /auth/step-up {action:'address_add'} → 200 with 6-digit preview_code. 5 wrong codes on POST /wallet/addresses → 5×400 'Invalid or expired confirmation code'; correct code afterwards also → 400 (code invalidated after 5 failed attempts).
detailed_results.R2_stepup_single_use: PASS — first save with correct code → 201, address_id=104 saved. Same code reused with a different address (0x1111...) → 400 (single-use).
detailed_results.R3_topup_simulate_403: PASS — GET /wallet/topup/coins?amount=10 → coin USDT-TRC20. POST /wallet/topup {amount:10,coin:'USDT-TRC20'} → 201, topup_id=95. POST /wallet/topup/95/simulate → 403 body contains 'disabled on this server'. GET /wallet → available=0.
detailed_results.R4_withdraw_zero_balance_no_row: PASS — fresh step-up cashout, POST /wallet/withdraw {address_id:104, amount:10, code} → 400 'Insufficient available balance'. RO SQL count(tbl_customer_withdrawal WHERE customer_id=966)=0 → no orphan row.
detailed_results.R5_per_route_rate_limits_independent: PASS — Telegram bucket: 21 hits → 21st = 429; IMMEDIATELY afterwards authed POST /auth/step-up → 200 (independent bucket). Step-up bucket exhausts on the 7th extra attempt (>10 used counting bootstrap/R1/R2/R4/R5 warmups) → 429 confirmed.
detailed_results.R6_regression_quick: PASS — send-code for real gmail → 200, NO preview_code in data. GET /config → live_settlement=false, simulation_allowed=false.
detailed_results.R7_cleanup: DONE — customer_ids purged: [964, 965, 966] (964 & 965 from bootstrap-503-retries; 966 was the surviving bootstrap that ran the tests). Deleted rows: tbl_customer_payout_address=1, tbl_safedeal_topup=1, tbl_safedeal_profile=3, tbl_customer=3 (transactions/withdrawals/wallet had 0). Final SELECT count(*) FROM tbl_customer WHERE customer_id IN (964,965,966) = 0.

critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/safedeal/wallet does not include customer_id in response body — testing had to look it up via DB. Consider surfacing customer_id (or wallet.customer_id) to reduce test/tooling coupling to the DB. Non-blocking.
test_credentials: None required; throwaway example.com identities self-generated.
seed_data_creation: 3 throwaway example.com customers created and fully purged in R7.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Per-route rate-limit buckets are confirmed independent (telegramLimiter, stepUpLimiter, addressLimiter, withdrawLimiter, simulateLimiter all isolated). Step-up preview_code is 6 digits, single-use, and invalidates after 5 wrong attempts. Top-up simulate always 403 with 'disabled on this server' (gate runs before lookup — verified via successful topup_id 95). Zero-balance withdraw is fully transactional (no orphan row). Real-domain send-code never leaks preview_code. /config reports live_settlement=false, simulation_allowed=false. Cleanup helper: /app/backend/scripts/cleanup_r225.js. RO SQL helper: /app/backend/scripts/ro_query.js. Note tbl_customer email column is `email` (not `customer_email`).
rca of the issue: N/A — this was a green retest confirming the previous fix (shared 'strict' bucket → per-route buckets). Only pre-test flakiness: preview pod occasionally returns 503 'Backend starting' for a few seconds on cold connections; the test suite handles this via a post_retry/get_retry wrapper (up to 20×3s).
